_about: Bruce Rock tandem dolly, parts table version 2. One table for the page and the renders. Part numbers and quantities marked bom come from the client parts list; prices are demo values.
node_ids: Every node name in the model starts with n and four digits, then the original CAD name, for example 'n0320 LARGE AIR TANK NEW:1'. Strip everything except letters and digits and read ^N(\d{4}) to get the id.
rule: A line owns every mesh under the nodes it lists. Highlight exactly those. The render shows the same geometry (one instance when a part repeats). When a clicked mesh belongs to several lines, pick the line with the smallest mesh_count, then offer its parent.

status_values.mapped: part number matched to the parts list
status_values.needs: geometry located, identity or part number unknown
